unit.why: A short anecdote: the Great Maggid's disciples argue over what he taught, and he settles it by saying both versions are included in his words.
unit.boundary_note: The trailing heading 'מענין תיקון ליל שבועות' introduces the next division.

stories.start_quote: סיפר אשר בין תלמידי המגיד הגדול
stories.end_quote: כי הדיבורים שאמרתי כולל דברי כולם
stories.summary_en: The Great Maggid's disciples disputed what he had said in a teaching, each claiming his own version, and the Maggid answered that both were 'words of the living God' because his words included all of theirs.

quotes: בין תלמידי המגיד הגדול ז״ל היה וויכוח
